facts.fact: Telecom Review Africa says 10 data centres are operating in Mauritius across Port Louis, Reduit, Arsenal, Quatre Bornes and Rose Belle, including Rogers Capital's co-location sites and the Bhumishq carrier-neutral facility; no opening dates given, so dated to the article.
facts.system: Rogers Capital Port Louis Data Center; Bhumishq Data Center

facts.fact: Harel Mallac Technologies Data Center in Port Louis is described as a Tier III data center among the 10 operating; the article gives no certifier, and no date beyond its own.
Bhumishq Data Center in Reduit is described as a Tier IV-designed carrier-neutral facility among the 10 operating; the article gives no certifier, and no date beyond its own.
The article names two operating Mauritian data centres as Tier III or IV, Harel Mallac Technologies (Tier III) and Bhumishq (Tier IV-designed), without naming a certifier.
